content.value: A hollow sphere of inside radius $r = a$ and outside radius $r = b$ is electrically heated at the inner surface at a constant rate of $q _ { o } \mathrm { ~ W / m } ^ { 2 }$ . At the outer surface it dissipates heat by convection into a fluid at temperature $T _ { \alpha }$ with a heat transfer coefficient h. The thermal conductivity k of the solid is constant. Develop expressions for the determination of the inner and outer surface temperatures $T _ { 1 }$ and $T _ { 2 }$ of the sphere. Calculate the inner and outer surface temperatures for $a = 3 \mathrm { c m } , b = 5 \mathrm { c m } , h = 4 0 0 W / m ^ { 2 } . ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } , T _ { \alpha } = 1 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } , k = 1 5 W / m . ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } ,$ and $q _ { o } { = } 1 0 ^ { 5 } \ W / m ^ { 2 }$
